Health Functional FoodNiacin 7mgVitamin A 350μgVitamin B1 0.5mgVitamin B12 1.1μgVitamin B2 0.6mgVitamin B6 0.7mgVitamin C 45mgVitamin D 5μgVitamin E 6mgPantothenic acid 2mgOnce a day

장인정신 에브리데이 키즈 멀티 비타 츄어블 레몬맛Niacin · Vitamin A · Vitamin B1 · Vitamin B12 · Vitamin B2 · Vitamin B6 · Vitamin C · Vitamin D · Vitamin E · Pantothenic acid

Made by 코스맥스엔비티(주) · Once a day · 1 tablet

This product combines 7mg of Niacin, 350μg of Vitamin A, 0.5mg of Vitamin B1, 1.1μg of Vitamin B12, 0.6mg of Vitamin B2, 0.7mg of Vitamin B6, 45mg of Vitamin C, 5μg of Vitamin D, 6mg of Vitamin E, 2mg of Pantothenic acid as labelled amounts. The officially recognised functions of each are listed below.

Why this product

  • Once a day (1 tablet): 7mg Niacin, 350μg Vitamin A, 0.5mg Vitamin B1, 1.1μg Vitamin B12, 0.6mg Vitamin B2, 0.7mg Vitamin B6, 45mg Vitamin C, 5μg Vitamin D, 6mg Vitamin E, 2mg Pantothenic acid
  • Coliform negative — meets its MFDS notified standard
  • Made by 코스맥스엔비티(주)

Officially recognised functions by ingredient

  • Niacin
    • Needed for energy production in the body
  • Vitamin A
    • Needed for the adaptation of vision in dim light
    • Needed to form and maintain skin and mucous membranes
    • Needed for the growth and development of epithelial cells
  • Vitamin B1
    • Needed for carbohydrate and energy metabolism
  • Vitamin B12
    • Needed for normal folate metabolism
  • Vitamin B2
    • Needed for energy production in the body
  • Vitamin B6
    • Needed for protein and amino acid utilisation
    • Needed to help maintain normal blood homocysteine levels
  • Vitamin C
    • Needed for the formation and maintenance of connective tissue
    • Needed for the absorption of iron
    • Needed to protect cells from harmful oxygen (free radicals)
  • Vitamin D
    • Needed for the absorption and utilisation of calcium and phosphorus
    • Needed for the formation and maintenance of bone
    • Recognised as helping reduce the risk of developing osteoporosis
  • Vitamin E
    • Needed to protect cells from harmful oxygen (free radicals)
  • Pantothenic acid
    • Needed for the metabolism of fat, carbohydrate and protein and for energy production

Directions (exactly as officially stated)

Once a day1 tablet per servingChew to take

Labelled standard

Niacin labelled (7mg / 1000mg), 80~150%
Vitamin A labelled (350μg / 1000mg), 80~150%
Vitamin B1 labelled (0.5mg / 1000mg), 80~180%
Vitamin B12 labelled (1.1μg / 1000mg), 80~180%
Vitamin B2 labelled (0.6mg / 1000mg), 80~180%
Vitamin B6 labelled (0.7mg / 1000mg), 80~150%
Vitamin C labelled (45mg / 1000mg), 80~150%
Vitamin D labelled (5μg / 1000mg), 80~180%
Vitamin E labelled (6mg / 1000mg), 80~150%
Pantothenic acid labelled (2mg / 1000mg), 80~180%
Appearance 고유의 향미가 있고 이미, 이취가 없는 연노란색의 원형 츄어블 정제
Coliform Negative
Shelf life 제조일로부터 24개월까지
Storage 실온/ 1. 직사광선을 피해 서늘한 곳에 보관하시고, 어린이의 손이 닿지 않는 곳에 보관하십시오. 2. 제품 개봉 후에는 흡습이 일어날 수 있으니 반드시 밀봉하여 보관하십시오.

Who it suits

  • Those who want to take Niacin · Vitamin A · Vitamin B1 · Vitamin B12 · Vitamin B2 · Vitamin B6 · Vitamin C · Vitamin D · Vitamin E · Pantothenic acid together daily
  • Those who prefer this form
  • Those who want a convenient way to manage multiple nutrients
Precautions · Consult a professional if you have hypercalcaemia or take medication · Stop use and consult a professional if adverse effects occur · Refer to the official cautions printed on the product

This product combines 7mg of Niacin, 350μg of Vitamin A, 0.5mg of Vitamin B1, 1.1μg of Vitamin B12, 0.6mg of Vitamin B2, 0.7mg of Vitamin B6, 45mg of Vitamin C, 5μg of Vitamin D, 6mg of Vitamin E, 2mg of Pantothenic acid as labelled amounts. The officially recognised functions of each are listed below.

Why this product

  • Once a day (1 tablet): 7mg Niacin, 350μg Vitamin A, 0.5mg Vitamin B1, 1.1μg Vitamin B12, 0.6mg Vitamin B2, 0.7mg Vitamin B6, 45mg Vitamin C, 5μg Vitamin D, 6mg Vitamin E, 2mg Pantothenic acid
  • Coliform negative — meets its MFDS notified standard
  • Made by 코스맥스엔비티(주)

Officially recognised functions by ingredient

  • Niacin
    • Needed for energy production in the body
  • Vitamin A
    • Needed for the adaptation of vision in dim light
    • Needed to form and maintain skin and mucous membranes
    • Needed for the growth and development of epithelial cells
  • Vitamin B1
    • Needed for carbohydrate and energy metabolism
  • Vitamin B12
    • Needed for normal folate metabolism
  • Vitamin B2
    • Needed for energy production in the body
  • Vitamin B6
    • Needed for protein and amino acid utilisation
    • Needed to help maintain normal blood homocysteine levels
  • Vitamin C
    • Needed for the formation and maintenance of connective tissue
    • Needed for the absorption of iron
    • Needed to protect cells from harmful oxygen (free radicals)
  • Vitamin D
    • Needed for the absorption and utilisation of calcium and phosphorus
    • Needed for the formation and maintenance of bone
    • Recognised as helping reduce the risk of developing osteoporosis
  • Vitamin E
    • Needed to protect cells from harmful oxygen (free radicals)
  • Pantothenic acid
    • Needed for the metabolism of fat, carbohydrate and protein and for energy production
